facts.statement: Fossils of Bystrowisuchus have been found in the Olenekian-age Lipovskaya Formation in the Ilovlinsky District.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found in the Olenekian-age Lipovskaya Formation in Ilovlinsky District.

facts.statement: The type species of the genus Bystrowisuchus is Bystrowisuchus flerovi.
facts.quote: The type species is Bystrowisuchus flerovi.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Bystrowisuchus was discovered near the eastern banks of the Don River in the Ilovlinsky District of Volgograd Oblast.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen of Bystrowisuchus was found near the eastern banks of the Don River in Ilovlinsky District, Volgograd Oblast.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Bystrowisuchus flerovi consists of six neck vertebrae and a partial right hip bone.
facts.quote: Bystrowisuchus flerovi is based on a holotype specimen including six cervical or neck vertebrae and a partial right ilium or hip bone.

facts.statement: The total body length of Bystrowisuchus is estimated to be between 2 and 3 meters.
facts.quote: Its total body length is estimated at 2 to 3 m.
